title: RAW UNREVIEWED: an open learned relation-path script with written branching and complete22-sign carrier
summary: Invented restricted factual writing: every learned content root denotes one binary relation. The reader follows the current entity; explicit whole-word branch/return controls preserve reference and explicit negation controls preserve scope. Kinds and properties are learned identity filters rather than disjoint noun/adjective classes. A primitive root may be written repeatedly, with optional transparent joining of identical adjacent roots, and every name, space, clause boundary and overwide-word continuation has a fixed22-working-sign realization. This is a complete restricted teaching contract and a separate concealed hand-reading packet, not a natural-language identification, statistical writer selection or native word assignment.

complete_contract.blinding: Root should initially receive only rules and challenge paths, plus these fixed hashes. Expected content remains unread until root freezes its own hand readback. The public demonstration in the rules uses a different combination. This is a source-concealed comprehension probe, not an independent statistical or native test. No decoder program is provided or required.

central_rule.purpose: Compactly describe a thing through a chain of familiar relationships, returning to a written branch point when a second fact concerns the same thing. The current entity replaces repeated full noun phrases, but it never identifies an unspoken particular object.
central_rule.learned_words: The open lexicon consists of primitive sign strings paired with fully learned binary relation definitions. An identity-filter relation pays the meaning of a kind/property without changing the current entity. There is no N/V/J initial classification, no fixed1-or2-NP clause frame, no field-number codebook and no assumption of29 universal roots.
central_rule.composition: A root power B^n expands to n successive applications of that exact relation. B B, BB and corresponding longer partitions remain readable with identical expanded relation content. Joining equal adjacent roots is optional and visible; unlike roots must retain their external boundary. An unrelated meaning for a nonprimitive power is forbidden, not resolved by longest-match guessing.
central_rule.scope: Positive or negative clause-start controls explicitly introduce or deny existential path descriptions. Written positive/negative branches save the current entity and a written return restores it. A name item constrains that entity to a spelled constant. All semantic participants are either named or explicitly quantified by these learned operations.
central_rule.unknowns: Unknown proper names are preserved character for character by a fixed83-cell character table. Unknown ordinary predicates require real lexical learning; a name cannot silently stand for their meaning. Unsupported characters and meanings are explicit domain stops.

hand_costs.fixed_signs_and_controls: 22 working marks;9 reserved two-mark whole controls; ordinary external spaces. Controls are complete words, never q-prefix selectors. All22 marks are otherwise available inside and at the ends of learned primitive roots. The demo has7 independently learned binary relation entries; an actual historical text would pay its actual lexicon, not merely these7.
hand_costs.name_channel: 83 explicitly listed character cells,4 row labels,21 column labels. An m-character name pays2m working marks plus dd/yy's4 marks, external spaces and any continuation. No hidden whole-name dictionary or silent normalization.
hand_costs.physical_layout: A declared24-cell teaching sheet; ordinary wrapping preserves group boundaries. A word too long for a line is split with a separate visible ss trailer after a blank, and pieces are rejoined before grammar. Name chunks stop at character-pair boundaries. Native line width, word segmentation and equivalent physical cell widths are not claimed.
hand_costs.memory: One current entity and the stack of explicitly written branch points; lexical recall and optional chart lookup for names; awareness of the available ruled cells. Deep branches cost retracing or a visible scratch tally. Long unfamiliar powers cost identifying the primitive root. No claim of constant-memory ease.
hand_costs.not_free: Learned vocabulary is a real collection of spelling-to-meaning pairs. This construction does not claim that renaming codewords 'language' saves those pairs. Its productive benefit is repeated relation composition and reference by written path, not compression proven on a corpus.
hand_costs.unpaid_for_statistical_selection: No historical source has been converted to the declared relation descriptions. Root lengths and lexical inventory are not fitted or identified. Optional joining has a complete semantic inverse but no frozen stochastic/deterministic occurrence-choice policy; such a policy is necessary before claiming a generated frequency profile. The7-entry lesson cannot itself account for the full native vocabulary.

manual_known_shape_review.assumption: Only conditional compatibility of the carrier language with known whole-group working-sign patterns is discussed. It is not a native atom proof, root assignment, lexical profile or empirical fit.
manual_known_shape_review.identical_neighbours: Any taught primitive relation root may appear in AAA or X Y X. No N/V/J type transition or mandatory maximal merge forbids them, and no fixed small set of initial prefixes is required. Thus the supplied qokedy and sheol/okaiin/chol triple obligations do not produce the previous noun-class proof. This permits shapes; it does not predict their frequency or meanings.
manual_known_shape_review.whole_powers: For any two different working marks A and B, AB is primitive, so AB and ABAB can both be content words; ABAB AB expands to three relation links. This avoids947's doubled-action-head/strict-nominal-next-word requirement without claiming that ol means a relation or olol means two steps.
manual_known_shape_review.interiors_and_terminals: Primitive roots of length>=2 have no restricted internal or final alphabet. Consequently the grammar has no1193 three-interior-sign cap or1195 six-short-final cap, and it does not structurally exclude the supplied4/5/8 interior-type requirements or12 short-word terminal types. Actual learned meanings for those shapes remain entirely unpaid and unassigned.
manual_known_shape_review.q_and_y: q is an ordinary root mark, not an8-selector control prefix, so qok is not mechanically prohibited inside a root. This does not explain common q-o starts or final-y concentration. Both remain untested obligations; no new q/o rule was added to match them.
manual_known_shape_review.unexplained_families: The contract explains full-root powers only. It does not yet give an independently justified common semantic stem or outer ending to daldy/daldaldy, daldy/daly/dal or any other native family. Assigning independent values to every longer form would pay separate lexical entries and would not establish native morphology.

strongest_concrete_counterexamples_and_l: Returning from a branch to its last endpoint rather than its written starting entity changes the source proposition. The public example already gives a leaf-beside-vessel versus leaf-inside-vessel contrast; a hidden nearest-noun rule is not allowed.

Negating a whole existential description differs from affirming an object with a negative property or prohibiting an action. The two explicit negation positions must remain readable. No context guess can repair a missing branch return or clause close.

An ordinary lexeme with independent spelling B^n for n>1 is unavailable; only the stipulated compositional meaning is licensed. This is a real lexical restriction. A fixed historical lexicon containing such unrelated wholes would require a different contract, not a silent exception.

Every complete clause actually writes aa or rr and ends with oo, and every branch/name writes its controls. These frequent exact words and their doubled-sign shapes are major future form/frequency obligations. A claimed direct application cannot omit them or invent unseen clause boundaries. No complete native message boundary has been selected in this RAW.

Unnamed variables in different branches or clauses do not silently co-refer. The reader cannot recover an intended same anonymous object, two distinct witnesses, a count, tense, directive or other undeclared distinction. The input domain must reject such a demand or express it with separately learned and actually written relations/names; the present example does not pretend general historical coverage.

Optional equal-root compounding is meaningful and completely readable, but leaves spelling variation as an explicit production choice. It cannot be used to tune target frequencies without a new predeclared choice contract. Lossless reading alone is not a writer-screen pass.

Here powers compose binary relation links and do not count distinct set members; branches and controls provide a different complete22-sign grammar. No nominal plural/cardinality reading is exported.

951 retained a fixed named topic; this rule normally advances the current entity and explicitly returns only at branch close.954's successful blind reading and fixed q-selector/typed-argument failures remain. The later noun-class draft's three-versus-two triple-initial contradiction remains. This proposal changes the entire semantic composition and control placement rather than growing those prefix classes. It reuses only the finite83-character literal chart and the explicitly paid physical continuation pattern.
